    Lemma 8.8 for incidence algebras of posets with unique paths #

    local-ray-geometry.tex (lem:dimension-infinity and the table after it): "For the relation-free diagrams used below the required vectors are […] These counts depend only on the underlying graphs; for a tree any orientation is allowed."

    Here: a finite poset P with a set E of arrows (x < y) such that between comparable points there is exactly one E-path. Its incidence algebra is the path algebra of E, so a right module of dimension vector d is a tuple of matrices on the arrows, and isomorphism is conjugation by ∏ GL_{d v} (isoConj). If ∑ d_v² ≤ ∑_{x → y} d_x d_y and d ≠ 0, the incidence algebra is representation-infinite (not_isRepresentationFinite): finite representation type would give finitely many orbits (exists_labels_iso), contradicting OrbitDim.orbits_not_finite with F = 0.
